title: Source normalization for a closed section
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting P of [def-pur-conventions]. Let B and X be schemes, with B separated and of finite type over the base field k by a structure map b:B→Spec k, and let f:X→B be separated, locally of finite type and quasi-compact with a retained compactification c of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let s:B→X be a closed immersion with quasi-compact complementary open and s followed by f equal to the identity of B. Use the canonical objects and comparisons of [def-pur-closed-section-compact-origin-data]. Then beta_c evaluated on s_*^e A_B, followed by Rf_!^p(epsilon_s) and Sigma_p, equals C_B(Sigma_e) followed by chi_B. Here epsilon_s is the actual supported-constant counit mate and chi_B is the fixed constant-sheaf comparison; Sigma_e and Sigma_p are the prescribed proper/composition/identity-normalized maps. No target complex or class map is involved.

source.place: Step 1, induced global morphism: source normalization after the closed-image square

proof.text: Apply the closed single-object compact-support normalization to the constant etale sheaf and use the underived counit mate to identify the supported constant comparison.

Paste beta naturality, candidate comparison naturality, the transported origin composition square, equality transport, and identity transport. The section equation hs identifies the composite with the identity, yielding the displayed Sigma source equation.

lean.statement:
theorem closedSectionSourceNormalization
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {B X : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated b] [LocallyOfFiniteType b] [QuasiCompact b]
    (f : X ⟶ B) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (s : B ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    [QuasiCompact s.openComplement.ι] (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 B) :
    (compactComparison P c (etaleSource P s)).hom ≫
        (ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) c).map (supportedComparison P s).hom ≫
        (proSigma P f c s hs).hom =
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (etaleSigma P f c s hs).hom) ≫
        (constantComparison P B).hom
